implementation.worktree_state: uncommitted adaptive rebuild, harness repairs and candidate integration additions

validation_storage.kernel_storage: same-volume hard links; source files must remain unchanged
validation_storage.metadata_and_ledgers: separately copied and fully checksum verified

all_body_integration.time_contract: UT1 input rebound to exact JD(TDB), normally 2460676.5 or a representative covered epoch inside the true-date frame interval
all_body_integration.source_contract: every body must carry the exact candidate catalog version, manifest hash, shard hash and shard byte count; no ambient catalogs are opened
all_body_integration.segment_contract: native catalogs; exact per-shard body rosters; Sun center 10; ICRF frame 1; SPK Type 13
all_body_integration.evidence_class: finite-state, adapter and release-provenance invariants; not independent authority validation for every catalog member

asteroid_passages.source: official NASA/JPL Horizons; retained raw exact-TDB responses and independent root-search generator captures

initial_discrepancy.diagnosis: Historical unanchored and catalog-endpoint-anchored Horizons integrations are different trajectory products. Same-day unanchored controls reproduce the historical distances exactly with unchanged JPL solution labels; independently solved anchored roots agree with candidate states.

network_boundary: pytest runs were denied external access; separate, bounded source-candidate probes intentionally queried official Horizons
limitations: All-body integration samples one representative epoch per body, not every instant across every catalog interval.
The asteroid oracle sample is six events for four bodies; the comet sample is three events for two bodies. Builder certification and all-body integration are separate evidence classes.
The comet authority snapshot is from 2026-10-01; no new full 497-body orbit-solution freshness census was performed in this integration step.
The literal complete engine suite was not run. These checks do not themselves complete versioning, clean builder provenance, immutable release preparation, packaging, installation or publication.
Validation-view kernels share storage with their source candidates and must never be published as immutable releases.
